The '''Catlia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Space]] area of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Catlia]], and was connected by the [[Phalanx Route]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] to the [[Cormit system/Legends|Cormit system]]. Catlia served as an outlying [[Colonist/Legends|colony]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Catlia system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed it in grid square G-8.<ref name="TEA" />
